cohort: The study included a weighted sample of 353,483 women who had given birth within the last five years in 35 sub-Saharan African countries.
finding: Less than one in three mothers (28.58%) received quality intrapartum care, and factors such as age, educational status, wealth, and residence were significantly associated with it.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with the quality of intrapartum care (AOR = 0.71).
cross-section timing: Data from Demographic and Health Surveys conducted between 2006 and 2022, focusing on women who had given birth within the five years prior to each survey.
